video_title: Kenrich Williams on Team's Mindset | Postgame Media | November 23, 2026

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the importance of competing in every game
quotes.excerpt: It's easy to make excuses in this league, but as long as you compete, you give yourself a chance.
quotes.quote: I think we came out and competed. That's the main battle, is competing, not laying down. It's easy to make excuses in this league, but as long as you compete, you give yourself a chance every night. I'm proud of the guys, the effort that we showed. We came up short, but there's things to build off of.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says the main battle for the Thunder is simply competing and not laying down despite the loss

structured.context: Kenrich Williams discusses the team's effort and mindset following a postgame loss.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on adjusting to a roster with many new players
quotes.excerpt: The principles don't change throughout the years, it's been the same, but it's going to be adjustment.
quotes.quote: It's an adjustment. The principles don't change throughout the years, it's been the same, but it's going to be adjustment. Playing with new guys and the younger guys having to step up early and learn the system. With reps, you gain confidence on that side of the ball, so we'll be better. It's only November, so we still got a lot of room for growth and we'll be better.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams on the Thunder adjusting to a new roster: It is only November so we still have a lot of room for growth

structured.context: Kenrich Williams talks about the adjustment period for the team's younger players and integrating new roster members.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on taking the season one game at a time
quotes.excerpt: Taking it one game at a time, keeping our heads where we're at right now.
quotes.quote: Taking it one game at a time, keeping our heads where we're at right now, where our feet are. It'll come along. I'm not worried about that. I've been on both sides, so there's room for growth. We can get better as a team and everybody including myself. We take these steps and just keep chipping away.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says the team is focused on taking it one game at a time and keeping their heads where their feet are

structured.context: Kenrich Williams shares his perspective on the team's long-term growth and maintaining a focused approach.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: He is one of the most competitive guys that I've ever been around.
quotes.quote: He is one of the most competitive guys that I've ever been around. Not just the game of basketball, it's just everyday, how he attacks the day. He always just shows up for a moment and he's super competitive.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams calls Shai Gilgeous-Alexander one of the most competitive guys he has ever been around

structured.context: Kenrich Williams praises the competitive nature of his teammate Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the challenges of playing with different teammates
quotes.excerpt: You got to learn and adapt to new guys and their playstyle.
quotes.quote: I would say just learning how guys want the ball and tendencies. Coming into the season, you pretty much knew who was going to play night in and night out, and things change like that. You got to learn and adapt to new guys and their playstyle. It's not hard, but it takes longer than a month. It goes both ways, the younger guys having to adjust to the way I play or the way Shai plays. There's always room for growth and we'll be better.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams on the learning curve of playing with new teammates: It is not hard but it takes longer than a month to learn tendencies

structured.context: Kenrich Williams explains the process of learning the tendencies and playstyles of new teammates.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on his experience playing the five position
quotes.excerpt: I just try to show up for my team and get my best effort.
quotes.quote: I definitely think back to those times, just battling, just doing whatever the team needs me to do. Whether that's playing a five or playing any position on the court, I just try to show up for my team and get my best effort. I just try to figure out what the team needs at that time, at that position, and just try to go attack.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says he is willing to play any position the team needs him to play to give his best effort

structured.context: Kenrich Williams reflects on his willingness to play different positions to support the team.
